verses.text_uthmani: حمٓ

translations.text: Ha Mim
Haa Meem

verses.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

translations.text: A revelation from the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy;
Yeh khuda e Rehman o Raheem ki taraf se nazil karda cheez hai

verses.text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: a Scripture whose verses are made distinct as a Quran in Arabic for people who understand,
Ek aisi kitaab jiski aayat khoob khol kar bayan ki gayi hain, Arabi zubaan ka Quran, un logon ke liye jo ilm rakhte hain

verses.text_uthmani: بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

translations.text: giving good news and warning. Yet most of them turn away and so do not hear.
Basharat(khush-khabri) dene wala aur dara dene wala magar in logon mein se aksar ne issey ru-gardani ki aur woh sunkar nahin detey

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ قُلُوبُنَا فِىٓ أَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنۢ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَٱعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَـٰمِلُونَ

translations.text: They say, ‘Our hearts are encased against [the faith] you call us to; our ears are heavy; there is a barrier between us and you. So you do whatever you want, and so shall we.’

Kehte hain “Jis cheez ki taraf tu humein bula raha hai uske liye hamare dilon par gilaf (purde) chade huey hain, hamare kaan behrey (deaf) ho gaye hain, aur hamare aur tere darmiyaan ek hijab hayal ho gaya hai. Tu apna kaam kar, hum apna kaam kiye jayenge”

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ فَٱسْتَقِيمُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ۗ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ

translations.text: Say [Prophet], ‘I am only a mortal like you, [but] it has been revealed to me that your God is One. Take the straight path to Him and seek His forgiveness. Woe to the idolaters,

Aey Nabi , insey kaho, mein to ek bashar hoon tum jaisa. Mujhey wahee ke zariye se bataya jaata hai ke tumhara khuda to bas ek hi khuda hai, Lihaza tum seedhey usi ka rukh ikhtiyar karo aur ussey maafi chaho. Tabahi hai un mushrikon ke liye

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: who do not pay the prescribed alms and refuse to believe in the world to come!
Jo zakat nahin detay aur aakhirat ke munkir hain

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

translations.text: Those who believe and do good deeds will have a reward that never fails.’
Rahey woh log jinhon ne maan liya aur neik aamaal kiye, unke liye yaqeenan aisa ajar hai jiska silsila kabhi tootne wala nahin hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: Say, ‘How can you disregard the One who created the earth in two Days? How can you set up other gods as His equals? He is the Lord of all the worlds!’
Aey Nabi! Insey kaho, kya tum us khuda se kufr karte ho aur dusron ko uska humsar (shareek / equals) thehratey ho jisne zameen ko do (two) dino mein bana diya? Wahi to saarey jahan waalon ka Rubb hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَـٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقْوَٰتَهَا فِىٓ أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ

translations.text: He placed solid mountains on it, blessed it, measured out its varied provisions for all who seek them––all in four Days.

Usne (zameen ko wajood mein laane ke baad) upar se ispar pahadh (mountains) jamaa diye aur ismein barakatein rakh di aur iske andar sab maangne waalon ke liye har ek ki talab o haajat ke mutaabiq theek andaze se khuraak ka saaman muhaiyya kardiya. Yeh sab kaam chaar (four) din mein ho gaye

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِىَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ٱئْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ

translations.text: Then He turned to the sky, which was smoke––He said to it and the earth, ‘Come into being, willingly or not,’ and they said, ‘We come willingly’––

Phir woh aasmaan ki taraf mutwajjeh huwa Jo us waqt mehaz dhuwan (smoke) tha. Usne aasman aur zameen se kaha “wajood mein aa jao, khwa tum chaho ya na chaho.” Dono ne kaha “ hum aa gaye farma bardaron ki tarah”

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَاتٍ فِى يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِى كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

translations.text: and in two Days He formed seven heavens, and assigned an order to each. We have made the nearest one beautifully illuminated and secure. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All Knowing.

Tab usne do din ke andar saath (seven) aasmaan bana diye, aur har aasmaan mein us ka kanoon wahee (reveal) kardiya. Aur aasmaan e duniya ko humne chiraagon (lamps) se aarasta (adorn) kiya aur isey khoob mehfooz kardiya. Yeh sab kuch ek zabardast hasti ka mansooba (plan) hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَـٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صَـٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ

translations.text: If they turn away, say, ‘I have warned you about a blast like the one which struck 'Ad and Thamud:
Ab agar yeh log mooh moadte hain to insey kehdo ke “main tumko usi tarah ke ek achanak toot padne waley azaab se darata hoon jaisa Aad aur Samood par nazil hua tha.”

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: when their messengers came to them, from all angles, saying, “Serve no one but God,” they said, “If our Lord had wished, He would have sent down angels. We do not believe in the message with which you have been sent.”

Jab khuda ke Rasool unke paas aagey aur peechey, har taraf se aaye aur unhein samjhaya ke Allah ke siwa kisi ki bandagi na karo to unhon ne kaha “hamara Rubb chahta to farishte bhejta, lihaza hum us baat ko nahin maante jiske liye tum bheje gaye ho.”

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

translations.text: The people of 'Ad behaved arrogantly throughout the land without any right, saying, “Who could be stronger than us?” Did they not realize that God, who created them, was stronger than them?’ They continued to reject Our message,

Aad ka haal yeh tha ke woh zameen mein kisi haqq ke bagair baday ban baithey aur kehne lagey: “ kaun hai humse zyada zoorawar?” Unko yeh na soojha ke jis khuda ne unko paida kiya hai woh unse zyada zoorawar hai? Woh hamari aayat ka inkaar hi karte rahey

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىٓ أَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ

translations.text: so We let a roaring wind loose on them for a few disastrous days to make them taste the punishment of shame in this world; more shameful still will be the punishment of the life to come, and they will not be helped.

Aakhir e kaar humne chandh manhoos dino mein sakht toofaani hawa unpar bhej di taa-ke unhein duniya hi ki zindagi mein zillat o ruswayi ke azaab ka maza chakha dein.Aur aakhirat ka azaab to issey bhi zyada ruswa-kun hai. Wahan koi unki madad karne wala na hoga

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَٱسْتَحَبُّوا۟ ٱلْعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَـٰعِقَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.text: As for Thamud, We gave them guidance but they preferred blindness, so they were struck by a blast of humiliating punishment for their misdeeds.
Rahey Samood, to unke samne humne raah e raast pesh ki magar unhon ne raasta dekhne ke bajaye andha (blind) bana rehna pasand kiya. Aakhir unke kartooton ki badaulat zillat ka azaab unpar toot pada

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ

translations.text: We saved those who believed and were mindful of God.
Aur humne un logon ko bacha liya jo imaan laaye thay aur gumrahi o bad-amali se parheiz karte thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَآءُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

translations.text: On the Day when God’s enemies are gathered up for the Fire and driven onward,
Aur zara us waqt ka khayal karo jab Allah ke yeh dushman dozakh ki taraf jaane ke liye ghair laaye jayenge unke agalon ko pichlon ke aane tak roak rakkha jayega

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: their ears, eyes, and skins will, when they reach it, testify against them for their misdeeds.
Phir jab sab wahan pahunch jayenge to unke kaan aur unki aankhein aur unke jism ki khaalein (skins) unpar gawahi dengi ke woh duniya mein kya kuch karte rahey hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنطَقَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.text: They will say to their skins, ‘Why did you testify against us?’ and their skins will reply, ‘God, who gave speech to everything, has given us speech- it was He who created you the first time and to Him you have been returned-

Woh apne jism ki khaalon se kahenge “ tumne hamare khilaf kyun gawahi di? “ woh jawab dengi “ humein usi khuda ne goyaii (speech) di hai jisne har cheez ko goya(speech) kardiya hai. Usi ne tumko pehli martaba paida kiya tha aur ab usi ki taraf tum wapas laaye ja rahey ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَآ أَبْصَـٰرُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: yet you did not try to hide yourselves from your ears, eyes, and skin to prevent them from testifying against you. You thought that God did not know about much of what you were doing,

Tum duniya mein jarahim (crime) karte waqt chupte thay to tumhein yeh khayal na tha ke kabhi tumhare apne kaan aur tumhari aankhein aur tumhare jism ki khaalein (skins) tumpar gawahi dengi balke tumne yeh samajha tha ke tumhare bahut se aamal ki Allah ko bhi khabar nahin hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَىٰكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ

translations.text: so it was the thoughts you entertained about your Lord that led to your ruin, and you became losers.’
Tumhara yahi gumaan jo tumne apne Rubb ke saath kiya tha, tumhein ley dooba aur isi ki badaulat tum khasare(loss) mein padh gaye”

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِن يَصْبِرُوا۟ فَٱلنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَسْتَعْتِبُوا۟ فَمَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُعْتَبِينَ

translations.text: The Fire will still be their home, even if they resign themselves to patience, and if they pray to be allowed to make amends, they will not be given permission to do so.
Is halat mein woh sabr karein (ya na karein) aag hi unka thikana hogi, aur agar rujoo ka mauqa chahenge to koi mauqa unhein na diya jayega

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوا۟ لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَوْلُ فِىٓ أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ

translations.text: We have appointed, for the disbelievers, companions who make their past and present seem fair and right to them, but the sentence has already been passed on them, along with generations of jinn and men before them: they were losers.

Humne unpar aisey saathi musallat kardiye thay jo unhein aagey aur peechey har cheez khushnuma banakar dikhate thay. Aakhir e kaar unpar bhi wahi faisla e azaab chaspan ho kar raha jo un se pehle guzray huey Jinno aur Insano ke girohon par chaspan ho chuka tha, yaqeenan woh khasare (loss) mein reh jaane waley thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَسْمَعُوا۟ لِهَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَٱلْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ

translations.text: The disbelievers say, ‘Do not listen to this Quran; drown it in frivolous talk: you may gain the upper hand.’
Yeh munkireen e haqq kehte hain “is Quran ko hargiz na sunoo aur jab yeh sunaya jaye to ismein khalal daalo, shayad ke is tarah tum gaalib aa jao”

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: We shall certainly give the disbelievers a taste of severe punishment. We shall repay them according to their worst deeds-
In kaafiron ko hum sakht azaab ka maza chakha kar rahenge aur jo badhtareen harakaat yeh karte rahey hain unka poora poora badla inhein dengey

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعْدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ۖ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

translations.text: that is the reward of the enemies of God- the Fire will be their lasting home, a payment for their rejection of Our revelations.
Woh dozakh hai jo Allah ke dushmano ko badley mein milegi, usi mein hamesha hamesha ke liye inka ghar hoga. Yeh hai saza is jurm ki ke woh hamari aayat ka inkar karte rahey

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ

translations.text: The disbelievers will say, ‘Our Lord, show us those jinn and men who misled us and we shall trample them underfoot, so that they may be among the lowest of the low.’

Wahan yeh kaafir kahenge ke “ aey hamare Rubb, zara humein dikha de un Jinno aur Insano ko jinhon ne humein gumraah kiya tha, hum unhein paon (legs) taley roondh daalein taa-ke woh khoob zaleel o khwar hon.”

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَبْشِرُوا۟ بِٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

translations.text: As for those who say, ‘Our Lord is God,’ and take the straight path towards Him, the angels come down to them and say, ‘Have no fear or grief, but rejoice in the good news of Paradise, which you have been promised.

Jin logon ne kaha ke Allah hamara Rubb hai aur phir woh ispar saabit qadam rahey, yaqeenan unpar farishtey nazil hotay hain, aur unsey kehte hain ke “na daro, na gham karo, aur khush ho jao us jannat ki basharat (khush khabri) se jiska tumse waada kiya gaya hai

verses.text_uthmani: نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَآؤُكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِىٓ أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ

translations.text: We are your allies in this world and in the world to come, where you will have everything you desire and ask for
Hum is duniya ki zindagi mein bhi tumhare saathi hain aur aakhirat mein bhi. Wahan jo kuch tum chahoge tumhein milega aur har cheez jiski tum tamanna karoge woh tumhari hogi

verses.text_uthmani: نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُورٍ رَّحِيمٍ

translations.text: as a welcoming gift from the Most Forgiving, Most Merciful One.’
Yeh hai samaan e ziyafat us hasti ki taraf se jo Gafoor aur Raheem hai”

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: Who speaks better than someone who calls people to God, does what is right, and says, ‘I am one of those devoted to God’?
Aur us shakhs ki baat se acchi baat aur kiski hogi jisne Allah ki taraf bulaya aur neik amal kiya aur kaha ke main musalman hoon

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَسْتَوِى ٱلْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّ حَمِيمٌ

translations.text: Good and evil cannot be equal. [Prophet], repel evil with what is better and your enemy will become as close as an old and valued friend,

[Aur aey Nabi], Neki aur badi yaksan (barabar) nahin hai, tum badi ko us neki se dafa karo jo behtareen ho, tum dekhoge ke tumhare saath jiski adawat (dushmani) padi hui thi woh jigri dost bangaya hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ

translations.text: but only those who are steadfast in patience, only those who are blessed with great righteousness, will attain to such goodness.
Yeh sifat naseeb nahin hoti magar un logon ko jo sabr karte hain, aur yeh muqaam haasil nahin hota magar un logon ko jo badey naseebey wale hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.text: If a prompting from Satan should stir you, seek refuge with God: He is the All Hearing and the All Knowing.
Aur agar tum shaytan ki taraf se koi uksahat (temptation) mehsoos karo to Allah ki panaah maang lo, woh sabkuch sunta aur jaanta hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِ ٱلَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ ۚ لَا تَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.text: The night, the day, the sun, the moon, are only a few of His signs. Do not bow down in worship to the sun or the moon, but bow down to God who created them, if it is truly Him that you worship.

Allah ki nishaniyon mein se hain yeh raat aur din aur Suraj aur Chand. Suraj ko aur Chand ko sajda na karo balke us khuda ko sajda karo jisne unhein paida kiya hai agar fil waqaii tum usi ki ibadat karne waley ho

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ ۩

translations.text: If the disbelievers are too arrogant, [remember, Prophet, that] those who are with your Lord glorify Him tirelessly night and day.

Lekin agar yeh log guroor mein aa kar apni hi baat par adey rahein to parwah nahin, jo farishtey tere Rubb ke muqarrab hain woh shab-o-roz(night and day) uski tasbeeh kar rahey hain aur kabhi nahin thakte

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلْأَرْضَ خَـٰشِعَةً فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَآءَ ٱهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

translations.text: Another of His signs is this: you see the earth lying desolate, but when We send water down on to it, it stirs and grows. He who gives it life will certainly give life to the dead. He has power over everything.

Aur Allah ki nishaniyon mein se ek yeh hai ke tum dekhte ho zameen sooni (barren) padi hui hai, phir joon-hi ke humne uspar paani barsaya, yakayak woh phabak uthti hai aur phool jaati hai (quivers and wells).Yakeenan jo khuda is mari (dead) hui zameen ko jila(zinda) uthata hai woh murdon ko bhi zindagi bakshne wala hai.Yaqeenan woh har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَآ ۗ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِىٓ ءَامِنًا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

translations.text: Those who distort the meaning of Our message are not hidden from Us. Is he who is hurled into the Fire better, or he who comes through safely on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you want, God certainly sees everything you do.

Jo log hamari aayat ko ultay maani pehnatay hain (pervert Our Signs) woh humse kuch chupe huey nahin hain. Khud hi sochlo ke aaya woh shaks behtar hai jo aag mein jhonka janey wala hai ya woh jo Qayamat ke roz aman ki halat mein haazir hoga? Karte raho jo kuch tum chaho, tumhari saari harkaton ko Allah dekh raha hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَـٰبٌ عَزِيزٌ

translations.text: Those who reject the Quran when it comes to them- though it is an unassailable Scripture
Yeh woh log hain jinke samne kalaam-e-naseehat aaya to unhon ne isey maan-ne se inkar kardiya, magar haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh ek zabardast kitaab hai

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ ۖ تَنزِيلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ

translations.text: which falsehood cannot touch from any angle, a Revelation sent down from the Wise One, Worthy of All Praise-
Baatil na saamne se ispar aa sakta hai na peechey se, yeh ek hakeem (most wise) o Hameed(Immensely Praiseworthy) ki nazil karda cheez hai

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

translations.text: [should remember that] you [Prophet] are not told anything that the previous messengers were not told: your Lord is a Lord of forgiveness, but also of painful punishment.

Aey Nabi, tumse jo kuch kaha jaa raha hai usmein koi cheez bhi aisi nahin hai jo tumse pehle guzrey huey Rasoolon se na kahi jaa chuki ho. Beshak tumhara Rubb bada darguzar karne wala hai, aur uske saath badi dardnaak saza dene wala hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَانًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥٓ ۖ ءَا۬عْجَمِىٌّ وَعَرَبِىٌّ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ هُدًى وَشِفَآءٌ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

translations.text: If We had made it a foreign Quran, they would have said, ‘If only its verses were clear! What? Foreign speech to an Arab?’ Say, ‘It is guidance and healing for those who have faith, but the ears of the disbelievers are heavy, they are blind to it, it is as if they are being called from a distant place.’

Agar hum isko ajami(non arabic) Quraan bana kar bhejte to yeh log kehte “Kyun na iski aayat khol kar bayan ki gayi? Kya ajeeb baat hai ke kalaam ajami (non-arabic) hai aur mukhatib arabi”.Insey kaho yeh quran imaan laanay walaon ke liye to hidayat aur shifaa hai, magar jo log iman nahin laatey unke liye yeh kaano ki daat (plug / behrapan) aur aankhon ki patti (covering) hai .Unka haal to aisa hai jaise unko door se pukara ja raha ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ

translations.text: We gave the Scripture to Moses but disputes arose about it- if it were not for a decree that had already been issued from your Lord, they would already have been judged- and still they are doubtful and suspicious of it.

Issey pehle humne Moosa ko kitaab di thi aur uske maamle mein bhi yahi ikhtilaf hua tha. Agar tere Rubb ne pehle hi ek baat tai na kardi hoti to in ikhtilaf karne walon ke darmiyan faisla chuka diya jata, aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh log uski taraf se sakht iztaraab angeiz (sakht bechain karne wale/disquieting) shakk mein paday huey hain

verses.text_uthmani: مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

translations.text: Whoever does good does it for his own soul and whoever does evil does it against his own soul: your Lord is never unjust to His creatures.
Jo koi neik amal karega apne hi liye accha karega, jo badi (evil) karega uska wabal usi par hoga, aur tera Rubb apne bandon ke haqq mein zaalim nahin hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۚ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتٍ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَاذَنَّـٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍ

translations.text: Knowledge of the Hour belongs solely to Him and no crop comes out of its sheath, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. On the Day He asks them, ‘Where are My partners?’ they will answer, ‘We admit to You that none of us can see [them]’:

Us sa-ath (hour/Qayamat) ka ilm Allah hi ki taraf raajeh hota hai, wahi un saare phalon (fruits) ko jaanta hai jo apne shagufon (coverings/sheath) mein se nilakte hain, usi ko maaloom hai ke kaunsi maada (female) hamila (conceive) hui hai aur kisne baccha janaa (give birth) hai. Phir jis roz woh in logon ko pukarega ke kahan hain mere woh shareek? Yeh kahenge, “hum arz kar chuke hain, aaj hum mein se koi iski gawahi dene wala nahin hai.”

verses.text_uthmani: وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَظَنُّوا۟ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ

translations.text: the gods they invoked before will have vanished away; they will know that there is no escape.
Us waqt woh sarey maabood insey ghum ho jaayenge jinhein yeh issey pehle pukarte thay, aur yeh log samajh lenge ke inke liye ab koi jaaye panaah nahin hai

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٌ قَنُوطٌ

translations.text: Man never tires of asking for good, but if evil touches him he loses all hope and becomes despondent.
Insaan kabhi bhalayi ki dua maangte nahin thakta, aur jab koi aafat ispar aa jaati hai to mayoos o dil shikasta ho jata hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَـٰذَا لِى وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ إِنَّ لِى عِندَهُۥ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ

translations.text: Whenever We let him taste some of Our mercy after he has been afflicted, he is sure to say, ‘This is all my own doing: I do not think the Hour will ever come, but even if I were to be taken back to my Lord, the best reward would await me with Him.’ We shall most certainly inform the disbelievers of what they have done and give them a taste of severe torment.

Magar junhi ke sakht waqt guzar jaane ke baad hum isey apni rehmant ka mazaa chakhate hain, yeh kehta hai ke “main isi ka mustahiq hoon, aur main nahin samajhta ke qayamat kabhi aayegi, lekin agar waqai main apne Rubb ki tarf paltaya gaya to wahan bhi mazey karunga”. Halanke kufr karne walon ko laziman hum bata kar rahenge ke woh kya karke aaye hain, aur unhein hum baday gandhey azaab ka maza chakhayenge

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضٍ

translations.text: Whenever We are gracious to man, he goes away haughtily, but, as soon as evil touches him, he turns to prolonged prayer.
Insaan ko jab hum niyamat detay hain to woh mooh pherta hai aur akad jata hai, aur jab usey koi aafat choo jaati hai to lambi chowdi duaein karne lagta hai

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ

translations.text: Say [Prophet], ‘Have you ever thought, what if this revelation really is from God and you still reject it? Who could be more astray than someone who cuts himself off so far [from God]?’

(Aey Nabi), insey kaho, kabhi tumne yeh bhi socha ke agar waqayi yeh Quran khuda hi ki taraf se hua aur tum iska inkar karte rahey to us shaks se badh kar bhatka hua aur kaun hoga jo iski mukhalifat mein door tak nikal gaya ho

verses.text_uthmani: سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْـَٔافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

translations.text: We shall show them Our signs in every region of the earth and in themselves, until it becomes clear to them that this is the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord witnesses everything?

Anqareeb hum unko apni nishaniyan aafaq (horizons)mein bhi dikhayenge aur inke apne nafs mein bhi yahan tak-ke inpar yeh baat khul jayegi ke yeh Quran waqayi barhaqq hai, kya yeh baat kaafi nahin hai ke tera Rubb har cheez ka shahid(witness) hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌۢ

translations.text: Truly, they doubt that they will meet their Lord; truly He encompasses everything.
Aagaah raho, yeh log apne Rubb ki mulaqaat mein shakk rakhte hain. Sun rakkho woh har cheez par muheet(fully encompasses everything) hai
